title: Juniper and the Crown
author: Tamsin Lockridge
blurb: Elodie Quintana, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
